text: The event loop explanation finally clicked for me here. I had watched 5 other videos and none of them made it this clear. Thank you!
Can you share the diagram you used around the 10 minute mark? I would love to use it as a reference while coding.
I was confused about middleware chaining at first but the order of operations example made it crystal clear. Well structured lesson.
The custom hooks pattern is so powerful. I refactored my entire data fetching logic into a useFetch hook and it cleaned up my components massively.
The groupby section is incredibly useful. Spent a lot of time with this in my job last week and your explanation made everything much clearer.
